objective: 学习 brainstorming 的核心行为控制力，并把它迁移到 research 的真实使用场景、资料/对象精准定位、判断交付和测试证据链。

brainstorming_essence.name: hard gate before costly work
brainstorming_essence.brainstorming_source: Do not implement before design approval.
brainstorming_essence.research_encoding: Do not enter Step 3+ deep analysis before scope/profile confirmation; do not complete formal report before self-review and user confirmation.

brainstorming_essence.name: anti-pattern blocks rationalization
brainstorming_essence.brainstorming_source: This is too simple to need a design.
brainstorming_essence.research_encoding: Research is not collecting sources; lightweight work still needs a decision package, formal work needs report self-review.

brainstorming_essence.name: ordered checklist with terminal state
brainstorming_essence.brainstorming_source: Checklist, process flow, user approval, terminal writing-plans handoff.
brainstorming_essence.research_encoding: Checklist and terminal state end only at confirmed lightweight decision, user-confirmed report, or explicit adjacent-skill route.

brainstorming_essence.name: step outputs have consumers
brainstorming_essence.brainstorming_source: Each step feeds the next: context, questions, approaches, design, spec, review, handoff.
brainstorming_essence.research_encoding: References now declare usage boundary, output contract, consumer step, failure state, and stop condition.

brainstorming_essence.name: self-review before user confirmation
brainstorming_essence.brainstorming_source: Spec self-review before asking the user to review the written spec.
brainstorming_essence.research_encoding: Formal reports require Report Self-Review before User Confirmation Gate.

brainstorming_essence.name: templates constrain behavior instead of filling blanks
brainstorming_essence.brainstorming_source: Design sections are scaled to complexity and reviewed incrementally.
brainstorming_essence.research_encoding: The single projection template declares use boundaries, removes vague ellipsis placeholders, and preserves evidence/challenge/failure conditions without file sprawl.

brainstorming_essence.name: source targeting before judgment
brainstorming_essence.brainstorming_source: Explore project context before proposing design.
brainstorming_essence.research_encoding: Research must first prove the target object and source set are correct, then qualify evidence and calibrate judgment.

success_standards.requirement: research 入口不是 brainstorming 外形复制，而是具备硬门禁、反模式、顺序 checklist、用户确认和终态停止。
references 承接入口流程，明确使用边界、输出合同、失败状态和不得越权行为。
projections 收敛为单一行为约束模板，不再保留分裂模板或省略号式含糊占位。
research 三类核心产出 selection、analysis、discovery 都被 eval 场景覆盖。
Claude Code 的 ultrathink 关键字保留。
research 真实使用场景明确限定为团队可能基于外部信息行动前的采用、选型、观点拆解、对象识别、判断复核和外部方案理解。
资料/对象精准定位先于判断校准，正式报告模板也必须先输出 Source Targeting Package 和 Evidence Qualification。

verification_commands.evidence: [PASS] shared Skill package quality baseline (30 skills, 6 static_warn reported)
